ei.subject: 공통영어1
ei.title: Culture Notes - Protecting Elves, Protecting Nature

fullPassage: Elves have been an important part of Iceland's folk culture and myths for centuries, and most Icelanders like to imagine that elves exist among them. Icelanders' interest in these imaginary beings gives them an emotional connection to nature. In Icelandic culture, it is important for people to respect and protect rocks and hills because they are homes for elves. Therefore, people think twice about digging up the country's beautiful natural landscapes. Also, plans for the construction of roads, factories, and bridges are sometimes changed. Thanks to the elves of Iceland, nature is being protected!

questions.passage: Elves have been an important part of Iceland's folk culture and myths for centuries, and most Icelanders like to imagine that elves ①<u>exist</u> among them. Icelanders' interest in these imaginary beings ②<u>give</u> them an emotional connection to nature. In Icelandic culture, it is important for people to ③<u>respect</u> and protect rocks and hills because they are ④<u>homes</u> for elves.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 부분 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.analysis: ✅ ①exist: 주어 elves(복수)에 맞는 동사원형으로 정상. ❌ ②give: 주어는 'Icelanders' interest'로 단수. 원문은 gives. 3인칭 단수 현재이므로 gives가 올바름. ✅ ③respect: to부정사 뒤 동사원형으로 정상. ✅ ④homes: 복수명사로 정상.
det.tip: 주어가 'A's interest(관심)'처럼 단수일 때는 동사에 -s를 붙인다. 주어-동사 수일치에 주의.

questions.passage: Elves have been an important part of Iceland's folk culture and myths for centuries. Icelanders' interest in these imaginary beings gives them an emotional connection to nature. In Icelandic culture, it is important for people ①<u>respecting</u> and protect rocks and hills because they are homes for elves. Therefore, people think twice about ②<u>digging</u> up the country's beautiful natural landscapes. Also, plans for the construction of roads, factories, and bridges are sometimes ③<u>changed</u>. Thanks to the elves of Iceland, nature is ④<u>being protected</u>!
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 부분 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: 사람들이 바위와 언덕을 존중하고 보호하는 것이 중요하다.
det.analysis: ❌ ①respecting: 원문은 'it is important for people to respect'. 'It is important for + 사람 + to V' 구문에서 to부정사가 필요. ✅ ②digging: 'think twice about digging'에서 전치사 about 뒤 동명사로 정상. ✅ ③changed: 수동태 'are changed'로 정상. ✅ ④being protected: 현재진행 수동태로 정상.
det.tip: It is important for + 사람 + to V: ~가 V하는 것이 중요하다. to 뒤에는 동사원형.

questions.passage: Elves have ①<u>been</u> an important part of Iceland's folk culture and myths for centuries, and most Icelanders like to imagine that elves exist among them. Icelanders' interest in these imaginary beings gives them an emotional connection to nature. In Icelandic culture, it is important for people to respect and protect rocks and hills because they are homes for elves. Also, plans for the construction of roads, factories, and bridges are sometimes ②<u>changed</u>. Thanks to the elves of Iceland, nature is ③<u>being</u> ④<u>protecting</u>!
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 부분 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.analysis: ✅ ①been: 현재완료 'have been'으로 정상. ✅ ②changed: 수동태 'are sometimes changed'로 정상. ✅ ③being: 현재진행 수동태의 일부로 정상. ❌ ④protecting: 원문은 'is being protected'. 현재진행 수동태(is being + p.p.)에서 과거분사가 와야 함. protecting(현재분사)은 능동 의미.
det.tip: 현재진행 수동태: is/am/are + being + p.p. (~되고 있다). protecting(능동) vs protected(수동).

questions.passage: Elves have been an important part of Iceland's folk culture and myths for centuries, and most Icelanders like to imagine that elves exist among them. Icelanders' interest in these imaginary beings gives them an emotional connection to nature. In Icelandic culture, it is important for people to respect and protect rocks and hills because ①<u>they</u> are homes for elves. Therefore, people think ②<u>twice</u> about digging up the country's beautiful natural landscapes. Also, plans for the ③<u>construction</u> of roads, factories, and bridges are sometimes changed. Thanks to the elves of Iceland, nature is being ④<u>protect</u>!
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 부분 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.analysis: ✅ ①they: rocks and hills를 가리키는 대명사로 정상. ✅ ②twice: 부사로 think를 수식. think twice(재차 생각하다)로 정상. ✅ ③construction: 전치사 for 뒤 명사로 정상. ❌ ④protect: 원문은 'is being protected'. 'is being + p.p.' 구조에서 과거분사가 와야 함. protect(동사원형)는 불가.
det.tip: is being + p.p.: 현재진행 수동태. protect(원형) → protected(과거분사). 수동태에는 과거분사 필수.

questions.passage: Elves have been an important part of Iceland's folk culture and myths for centuries, and most Icelanders like to imagine that elves exist among them. Icelanders' interest in these imaginary beings gives them an emotional connection to nature. In Icelandic culture, it is important for people to respect and protect rocks and hills because they are ①<u>habitats</u> for elves. Therefore, people think twice about ②<u>excavating</u> the country's beautiful natural landscapes. Also, plans for the construction of roads, factories, and bridges are sometimes ③<u>revised</u>. Thanks to the elves of Iceland, nature is being ④<u>demolished</u>!
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 단어 중, 문맥상 부적절한 것은?

det.analysis: ✅ ①habitats(서식지): homes(집)과 유사 의미. 적절. ✅ ②excavating(발굴하는): digging up(파헤치는)과 유사 의미. 적절. ✅ ③revised(수정된): changed(변경된)와 유사 의미. 적절. ❌ ④demolished(파괴된): 원문은 protected(보호받는). 자연이 '보호'되고 있으므로 demolished(파괴)는 정반대.
det.tip: protect(보호하다) ↔ demolish(파괴하다). 엘프 덕분에 자연이 보호된다는 긍정적 결론.

questions.passage: Elves have been an important part of Iceland's folk culture and myths for centuries, and most Icelanders like to imagine that elves exist among them. Icelanders' interest in these imaginary beings ①<u>grants</u> them an emotional connection to nature. In Icelandic culture, it is important for people to ②<u>disregard</u> and protect rocks and hills because they are homes for elves. Therefore, people think twice about digging up the country's beautiful natural ③<u>landscapes</u>. Also, plans for the construction of roads, factories, and bridges are sometimes ④<u>changed</u>.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 단어 중, 문맥상 부적절한 것은?

det.analysis: ✅ ①grants(제공하다): gives(준다)와 유사 의미. 적절. ❌ ②disregard(무시하다): 원문은 respect(존중하다). 바위를 '존중하고 보호하라'는 맥락에서 disregard는 정반대. ✅ ③landscapes(경관): 원문 그대로. ✅ ④changed(변경된): 원문 그대로.
det.tip: respect(존중하다) ↔ disregard(무시하다). dis- 접두사가 반대 의미를 만듦.

questions.passage: Elves have been an important part of Iceland's folk culture and myths for centuries, and most Icelanders like to imagine that elves exist among them. Icelanders' interest in these imaginary beings gives them an emotional connection to nature. In Icelandic culture, it is important for people to respect and protect rocks and hills because they are homes for elves.
questions.stem:
다음 글의 내용과 일치하면 T, 일치하지 않으면 F를 고르시오.
"아이슬란드인들은 엘프가 자신들 사이에 존재한다고 상상하기를 좋아한다."

det.analysis: ✅ T: 원문에 'most Icelanders like to imagine that elves exist among them'이라고 명시. 내용과 정확히 일치.
det.tip: like to imagine: 상상하기를 좋아하다. exist among them: 그들 사이에 존재하다.

questions.passage: Elves have been an important part of Iceland's folk culture and myths for centuries. Icelanders' interest in these imaginary beings gives them an emotional connection to nature. In Icelandic culture, it is important for people to respect and protect rocks and hills because they are homes for elves. Therefore, people think twice about digging up the country's beautiful natural landscapes.
questions.stem:
다음 글의 내용과 일치하면 T, 일치하지 않으면 F를 고르시오.
"아이슬란드에서 바위와 언덕을 보호해야 하는 이유는 그것들이 희귀한 광물을 포함하고 있기 때문이다."

det.korean: 바위와 언덕을 보호하는 이유는 엘프의 집이기 때문이다.
det.analysis: ❌ F: 원문에서 바위와 언덕을 보호하는 이유는 'they are homes for elves(엘프의 집이므로)'이다. 희귀 광물은 언급되지 않음.
det.tip: because 절의 이유를 정확히 파악해야 함. homes for elves ≠ 희귀 광물.

questions.passage: Icelanders' interest in these imaginary beings gives them an emotional connection to nature. In Icelandic culture, it is important for people to respect and protect rocks and hills because they are homes for elves. Therefore, people think twice about digging up the country's beautiful natural landscapes. Also, plans for the construction of roads, factories, and bridges are sometimes changed.
questions.stem:
다음 글의 내용과 일치하면 T, 일치하지 않으면 F를 고르시오.
"도로, 공장, 다리의 건설 계획은 엘프를 고려하여 항상 취소된다."

det.analysis: ❌ F: 원문은 'are sometimes changed(때때로 변경된다)'이다. '항상 취소된다'가 아님. sometimes(때때로) ≠ always(항상), changed(변경) ≠ cancelled(취소).
det.tip: sometimes(때때로) vs always(항상). changed(변경) vs cancelled(취소). 빈도와 행위 모두 다름.

questions.passage: Elves have been an important part of Iceland's folk culture and myths for centuries, and most Icelanders like to imagine that elves exist among them. Icelanders' interest in these imaginary beings gives them an emotional connection to nature. In Icelandic culture, it is important for people to respect and protect rocks and hills because they are __________. Therefore, people think twice about digging up the country's beautiful natural landscapes.
questions.stem: 다음 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.analysis: ❌ ①광물 자원: 원문에 언급 없음. ❌ ②관광 명소: 원문에 언급 없음. ✅ ③homes for elves: 원문 그대로. 바위와 언덕이 엘프의 집이므로 존중하고 보호한다. ❌ ④국가적 자부심의 상징: 원문에 언급 없음.
det.tip: because 뒤에 이유가 옴. 엘프 문화 → 바위/언덕 = 엘프의 집 → 보호.

questions.passage: Elves have been an important part of Iceland's folk culture and myths for centuries, and most Icelanders like to imagine that elves exist among them. Icelanders' interest in these imaginary beings gives them an emotional connection to nature. In Icelandic culture, it is important for people to respect and protect rocks and hills because they are homes for elves. Therefore, people think twice about digging up the country's beautiful natural landscapes. Also, plans for the construction of roads, factories, and bridges are sometimes changed. Thanks to the elves of Iceland, nature is being protected!
questions.stem: 다음 글의 요지로 보아, 엘프에 대한 아이슬란드인들의 믿음은 결과적으로 __________에 기여한다.

det.analysis: ❌ ①경제/관광: 원문에 언급 없음. ✅ ②자연환경 보존: 전체 글의 흐름이 엘프 믿음 → 바위/언덕 보호 → 자연경관 보존 → 건설 계획 변경 → 자연 보호로 이어짐. ❌ ③전통 종교: 원문에 종교 언급 없음. ❌ ④국제 교류: 원문에 언급 없음.
det.tip: 글의 인과 흐름: 엘프 믿음 → 존중/보호 → 자연 보호. 마지막 문장이 결론.

questions.passage: Elves have been an important part of Iceland's folk culture and myths for centuries, and most Icelanders like to imagine that elves exist among them. Icelanders' interest in these imaginary beings gives them an emotional connection to nature. In Icelandic culture, it is important for people to respect and protect rocks and hills because they are homes for elves.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 내용과 일치하는 것은?
ch: 엘프는 아이슬란드에서 최근에 만들어진 문화적 상징이다.
상상의 존재에 대한 관심이 자연에 대한 정서적 연결을 준다.
아이슬란드인들은 엘프가 실제로 존재한다는 것을 과학적으로 증명했다.
바위와 언덕은 아이슬란드에서 건축 자재로 활용된다.

det.korean: 상상의 존재에 대한 관심이 정서적 연결을 준다.
det.analysis: ❌ ①최근 만들어진 상징: 'for centuries(수 세기 동안)'이므로 최근이 아님. ✅ ②정서적 연결: 'gives them an emotional connection to nature'. 원문 그대로. ❌ ③과학적 증명: 원문은 'like to imagine(상상하기를 좋아한다)'이지 증명한 것이 아님. ❌ ④건축 자재: 원문에 언급 없음. 바위와 언덕은 엘프의 집.
det.tip: imaginary beings(상상의 존재) → emotional connection(정서적 연결). 사실이 아닌 상상/믿음.

questions.passage: In Icelandic culture, it is important for people to respect and protect rocks and hills because they are homes for elves. Therefore, people think twice about digging up the country's beautiful natural landscapes. Also, plans for the construction of roads, factories, and bridges are sometimes changed. Thanks to the elves of Iceland, nature is being protected!
questions.stem: 다음 글의 내용과 일치하는 것은?
ch: 아이슬란드 사람들은 자연경관을 적극적으로 개발하려 한다.
도로, 공장, 다리 건설 계획은 절대 변경되지 않는다.
엘프에 대한 믿음은 자연 파괴를 촉진한다.
건설 계획이 때때로 변경되어 자연이 보호받고 있다.

det.korean: 건설 계획이 때때로 변경되어 자연이 보호받고 있다.
det.analysis: ❌ ①적극 개발: 정반대. think twice(재고)한다. ❌ ②절대 변경 안 됨: 'sometimes changed(때때로 변경)'이므로 거짓. ❌ ③자연 파괴 촉진: 정반대. 자연이 보호됨. ✅ ④건설 계획 변경 → 자연 보호: 원문 흐름과 일치.
det.tip: think twice(재고하다) + sometimes changed(때때로 변경) = 자연 보호 효과.

questions.passage: Elves have been an important part of Iceland's folk culture and myths for centuries, and most Icelanders like to imagine that elves exist among them. ①Icelanders' interest in these imaginary beings gives them an emotional connection to nature. ②In Icelandic culture, it is important for people to respect and protect rocks and hills because they are homes for elves. ③Therefore, people are eager to dig up the country's beautiful natural landscapes. ④Also, plans for the construction of roads, factories, and bridges are sometimes changed.
questions.stem: 다음 글에서 원문의 내용과 다르게 표현된 부분을 고르시오.

det.korean: 사람들은 자연 경관을 파헤치는 것에 관해 재차 생각한다.
det.analysis: ✅ ①원문 그대로. ✅ ②원문 그대로. ❌ ③원문은 'people think twice about digging up'(재고한다)인데 'are eager to dig up'(파헤치기를 열망한다)로 변경됨. 정반대 의미. ✅ ④원문 그대로.
det.tip: think twice about(재고하다/주저하다) ≠ be eager to(열망하다). 태도가 정반대.

questions.passage: Elves have been an important part of Iceland's folk culture and myths for centuries, and most Icelanders like to imagine that elves exist among them. Icelanders' interest in these imaginary beings gives them an emotional connection to nature. In Icelandic culture, it is important for people to respect and protect rocks and hills because __________. Therefore, people think twice about digging up the country's beautiful natural landscapes.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말을 본문의 **영어** 표현을 사용하여 쓰시오.
accept: because they are homes for elves

det.analysis: 원문에서 'because they are homes for elves'라고 명시. 바위와 언덕을 보호하는 이유가 엘프의 집이라는 점.
det.tip: because 절에서 이유를 찾는다. homes for elves가 핵심.

questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말을 본문의 **영어** 단어로 쓰시오. (2단어)

det.analysis: 원문에서 'gives them an emotional connection to nature'. 엘프에 대한 관심 → 정서적 연결 제공.
det.tip: gives them an __________ __________ to nature에서 빈칸을 채우는 형태.

questions.passage: Elves have been an important part of Iceland's folk culture and myths for centuries, and most Icelanders like to imagine that elves exist among them. Icelanders' interest in these imaginary beings gives them an emotional connection to nature. questions.stem:

[people / the country's / about / think / twice / beautiful / digging up / natural landscapes]
questions.wa: people think twice about digging up the country's beautiful natural landscapes
accept: People think twice about digging up the country's beautiful natural landscapes
people think twice about digging up the country's beautiful natural landscapes.
People think twice about digging up the country's beautiful natural landscapes.

det.korean: 사람들은 아름다운 자연 지형을 파헤치는 것에 관해 재차 생각한다.
det.analysis: 주어(people) + 동사구(think twice) + 전치사구(about digging up) + 목적어(the country's beautiful natural landscapes). think twice about V-ing 구문.
det.tip: think twice about V-ing: ~하는 것에 대해 재고하다. 어순: S + V + about + V-ing + O.

questions.ans: people think twice about digging up the country's beautiful natural landscapes

questions.passage: Elves have been an important part of Iceland's folk culture and myths for centuries, and most Icelanders like to imagine that elves exist among them. ch: 엘프에 대한 믿음이 아이슬란드의 자연 보호에 미치는 영향
아이슬란드의 도로 건설 계획이 자주 변경되는 원인

자연환경 보호를 위한 아이슬란드 정부의 정책

det.korean: 엘프 믿음 → 바위/언덕 보호 → 자연경관 보존 → 자연 보호.
det.analysis: ✅ ①엘프 믿음 → 자연 보호: 글 전체의 인과관계. 엘프를 위한 존중이 결과적으로 자연을 보호. ❌ ②도로 건설: 부분적 내용일 뿐 주제가 아님. ❌ ③유럽 각국: 아이슬란드만 다룸. ❌ ④정부 정책: 정부 정책은 언급 없음. 민간 믿음 차원.
det.tip: 주제 = 글의 핵심 메시지. 마지막 문장 'Thanks to the elves, nature is being protected!'가 결론.

questions.passage: Elves have been an important part of Iceland's folk culture and myths for centuries, and most Icelanders like to imagine that elves exist among them. Icelanders' interest in these imaginary beings gives them an emotional connection to nature. In Icelandic culture, it is important for people to respect and protect rocks and hills because they are homes for elves. Therefore, people think twice about digging up the country's beautiful natural landscapes. Also, plans for the construction of roads, factories, and bridges are sometimes changed. Thanks to the elves of Iceland, nature is being protected!
questions.stem:
다음 글의 내용을 한 문장으로 요약할 때, 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?
"In Iceland, the belief in elves leads people to __________ natural environments."

det.korean: 아이슬란드에서 엘프에 대한 믿음은 사람들이 자연환경을 신중하게 보호하도록 이끈다.
det.analysis: ❌ ①적극 개발: 정반대. ❌ ②과학적 연구: 원문에 과학 언급 없음. ✅ ③신중하게 보호: think twice(재고) + protect(보호)의 흐름과 일치. ❌ ④완전히 무시: 정반대.
det.tip: 요약 = 핵심 인과관계 축약. 엘프 믿음 → 보호 행동.
